name: علوم و تحقیق
description: واژگان سطح B2 — موضوع: علوم و تحقیق

words.example: The scientist proposed a hypothesis before starting the experiment.
definitions: A proposed explanation made on the basis of limited evidence, used as a starting point for investigation
words.coreMeaning: پیشنهاد یا حدس علمی که باید آزمایش شود
words.note: جمع آن hypotheses است
words.trap: با theory اشتباه نگیرید؛ hypothesis حدس اولیه، theory نظریه اثبات‌شده

words.example: They conducted an experiment to test the new drug.
definitions: A scientific procedure undertaken to make a discovery, test a hypothesis, or demonstrate a known fact
words.coreMeaning: انجام یک فرآیند علمی برای کشف یا اثبات چیزی
words.note: هم اسم و هم فعل است

words.example: The researcher changed one variable at a time.
definitions: A factor or element that can change or be changed in a scientific experiment
words.coreMeaning: عاملی که در آزمایش تغییر می‌کند
words.note: در علوم: independent variable و dependent variable کلیدی هستند
words.trap: variable به معنی قابل تغییر هم هست

words.example: The methodology of the study was clearly described in the paper.
definitions: A system of methods used in a particular area of study or activity
words.coreMeaning: مجموعه روش‌های سیستماتیک برای انجام تحقیق
words.note: methodology فقط به معنی یک روش نیست
words.trap: با method اشتباه نشود؛ methodology کلی‌تر است

words.example: The data analysis revealed surprising results.
definitions: Detailed examination of the elements or structure of something
words.coreMeaning: بررسی دقیق و جزئی اجزای یک چیز
words.note: جمع آن analyses است

words.example: Darwin's theory of evolution changed biology forever.
definitions: A supposition or system of ideas intended to explain something, based on principles independent of the thing to be explained
words.coreMeaning: مجموعه‌ای از ایده‌ها برای توضیح یک پدیده علمی
words.note: در علم، theory نظریه‌ای است که با شواهد زیاد تأیید شده
words.trap: در محاوره theory گاهی به معنی حدس است

words.example: Careful observation is the first step of the scientific method.
definitions: The action or process of observing something carefully in order to gain information
words.coreMeaning: دقت و نگاه دقیق به چیزی برای کسب اطلاعات
words.note: observation می‌تواند هم عمل و هم نتیجه باشد
words.trap: observation بدون دخالت، experiment با دخالت

words.example: There is strong evidence to support the theory.
definitions: The available body of facts or information indicating whether a belief or proposition is true or valid
words.coreMeaning: اطلاعات و واقعیت‌هایی که یک ادعا را تأیید می‌کنند
words.note: evidence غیرقابل شمارش است
words.trap: evidence ≠ proof؛ evidence شواهد، proof قطعیت

words.example: The results were statistically significant.
definitions: Sufficiently great or important to be worthy of attention
words.coreMeaning: آنقدر مهم که ارزش توجه داشته باشد
words.note: در آمار: statistically significant یعنی نتیجه تصادفی نیست
words.trap: significant ≠ big؛ ممکن است تفاوت کوچک ولی معنادار باشد

words.example: Scientists quantified the amount of pollution in the river.
definitions: To express or measure the quantity of something
words.note: quantify معمولاً در تحقیقات علمی استفاده می‌شود
words.trap: quantify ≠ count؛ quantify اندازه‌گیری، count شمردن

words.example: We took a random sample of 200 people for the survey.
definitions: A small part or quantity intended to show what the whole is like
words.coreMeaning: بخش کوچکی از یک کل برای نمایش کل
words.note: sample size بسیار مهم است
words.trap: sample ≠ example؛ sample نمونه آماری، example مثال

words.example: The poll showed that most citizens support the new policy.
definitions: A survey of public opinion
words.note: poll می‌تواند هم اسم و هم فعل باشد
words.trap: poll ≠ vote؛ poll نظرسنجی، vote رأی‌دادن

words.example: The findings of the study were published in a major journal.
definitions: Information discovered as the result of an inquiry or investigation
words.coreMeaning: نتایج و اطلاعات حاصل از تحقیق
words.note: معمولاً به صورت جمع استفاده می‌شود
words.trap: findings ≠ results؛ findings کشفیات، results نتایج عددی

words.example: The paper went through a rigorous peer review process.
definitions: Evaluation of scientific work by others in the same field
words.coreMeaning: بررسی کار علمی توسط متخصصان همان حوزه
words.note: peer-reviewed بودن مجله نشانه اعتبار است

words.example: There is a strong correlation between smoking and lung cancer.
definitions: A mutual relationship or connection between two or more things
words.coreMeaning: رابطه متقابل بین دو یا چند چیز
words.note: همبستگی لزوماً به معنی علیت نیست

words.example: Flooding is a common occurrence in this region.
definitions: An incident or event; the fact of something happening
words.note: occurrence از فعل occur ساخته شده
words.trap: occurrence ≠ accident؛ occurrence عام، accident ناخوشایند

words.example: The researcher published her findings in a top journal.
definitions: A person who carries out academic or scientific research
words.coreMeaning: شخصی که تحقیقات علمی انجام می‌دهد
words.note: researcher می‌تواند در هر حوزه‌ای باشد

words.example: She is a respected scholar in the field of linguistics.
definitions: A specialist in a particular branch of study
words.note: scholar می‌تواند به معنی دانشجوی بورسیه هم باشد
words.trap: scholar ≠ scientist؛ scholar علوم انسانی، scientist علوم تجربی

words.example: The study was published in a peer-reviewed journal.
definitions: A periodical publication containing articles and research papers
words.note: مجلات معتبر peer-reviewed هستند
words.trap: journal ≠ magazine؛ journal علمی، magazine عمومی

words.example: Read the abstract to get an overview of the research paper.
definitions: A brief summary of the contents of an article or research paper
words.note: abstract معمولاً 150-300 کلمه است
words.trap: abstract ≠ summary؛ abstract خاص مقالات علمی

words.example: Every living organism needs energy to survive.
definitions: An individual animal, plant, or single-celled life form
words.note: organism با organization اشتباه نشود

words.example: Many species are endangered due to deforestation.
definitions: A group of living organisms consisting of similar individuals
words.coreMeaning: گروهی از موجودات زنده که قادر به تولید مثل با یکدیگرند
words.note: species هم مفرد و هم جمع است
words.trap: species ≠ kind؛ species اصطلاح علمی دقیق

words.example: The theory of evolution explains how species change over time.
definitions: The process of gradual development or change over generations
words.note: evolution فقط در زیست‌شناسی نیست
words.trap: evolution ≠ revolution؛ evolution تدریجی، revolution ناگهانی

words.example: Genes determine many of our physical characteristics.
definitions: A unit of heredity transferred from parent to offspring
words.coreMeaning: واحد ارثی که ویژگی‌های فرزند را تعیین می‌کند
words.note: gene از کلمه یونانی genos گرفته شده
words.trap: gene ≠ DNA؛ gene بخشی از DNA است

words.example: Humans have 23 pairs of chromosomes.
definitions: A structure found inside the nucleus of cells, made of DNA and proteins
words.coreMeaning: ساختاری در هسته سلول حاوی DNA
words.note: کروموزوم‌ها در جفت هستند

words.example: The cell is the basic unit of life.
definitions: The smallest structural and functional unit of an organism
words.note: cell معانی دیگری هم دارد: زندان، باتری
words.trap: cell ≠ battery؛ در زیست‌شناسی cell واحد زندگی

words.example: Proteins are essential for building and repairing body tissues.
definitions: Any of a class of nitrogenous organic compounds essential for living organisms
words.coreMeaning: ترکیبات آلی ضروری برای ساخت بافت‌ها
words.note: پروتئین‌ها از اسیدهای آمینه ساخته می‌شوند

words.example: Enzymes speed up chemical reactions in the body.
definitions: A protein that acts as a catalyst to speed up biochemical reactions
words.coreMeaning: پروتئینی که واکنش‌های شیمیایی را تسریع می‌کند
words.note: آنزیم‌ها بسیار اختصاصی هستند
words.trap: enzyme ≠ hormone؛ enzyme催化‌کننده، hormone پیام‌رسان

words.example: Some bacteria can cause serious infections.
definitions: Microscopic single-celled organisms found in every environment
words.note: bacteria جمع است؛ مفرد آن bacterium
words.trap: bacteria ≠ virus؛ bacteria موجود زنده، virus بدون میزبان زنده نیست

words.example: A water molecule consists of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
definitions: The smallest unit of a chemical compound that can exist independently
words.note: مولکول از اتم‌ها ساخته شده
words.trap: molecule ≠ atom؛ molecule ترکیبی از اتم‌هاست

words.example: Everything in the universe is made up of atoms.
definitions: The basic unit of a chemical element
words.note: اتم‌ها از proton، neutron و electron تشکیل شده‌اند
words.trap: atom ≠ molecule؛ atom واحد عنصر، molecule واحد ترکیب

words.example: Water is a compound made of hydrogen and oxygen.
definitions: A substance formed when two or more chemical elements are chemically bonded
words.coreMeaning: ماده‌ای از ترکیب دو یا چند عنصر
words.note: compound هم اسم و هم صفت است
words.trap: compound ≠ mixture؛ compound پیوند شیمیایی دارد

words.example: The chemical reaction produces heat and light.
definitions: A chemical process in which substances act on each other and are changed
words.note: reaction معانی دیگری هم دارد
words.trap: reaction ≠ response؛ reaction شیمیایی، response انسانی

words.example: Lemon juice contains citric acid.
definitions: A chemical substance with a pH of less than 7
words.coreMeaning: ماده شیمیایی با pH کمتر از 7
words.note: اسیدها خورنده هستند

words.example: Salt dissolved in water forms a solution.
definitions: A liquid mixture in which the minor component is uniformly distributed
words.note: solution معانی دیگری هم دارد: راه‌حل

words.example: Platinum acts as a catalyst in many chemical reactions.
definitions: A substance that increases the rate of a chemical reaction without being consumed
words.coreMeaning: ماده‌ای که سرعت واکنش را بدون تغییر خودش افزایش می‌دهد
words.note: کاتالیزور مصرف نمی‌شود

words.example: Gravity keeps the planets in orbit around the sun.
definitions: The force that attracts a body toward the center of the earth
words.coreMeaning: نیروی جاذبه بین اجسام دارای جرم
words.note: گرانش ضعیف‌ترین نیروی بنیادی طبیعت است
words.trap: gravity ≠ weight؛ gravity نیرو، weight نتیجه

words.example: Friction between the tires and the road helps the car stop.
definitions: The resistance that one surface encounters when moving over another
words.coreMeaning: مقاومت بین دو سطح در حال تماس
words.note: اصطکاک هم مفید و هم مضر است
words.trap: friction ≠ resistance؛ friction نوع خاصی از resistance

words.example: The velocity of the rocket increased as it left the atmosphere.
definitions: The speed of something in a given direction
words.note: velocity برداری است (جهت دارد)

words.example: The car gained momentum as it rolled down the hill.
definitions: The quantity of motion of a moving body, measured as mass times velocity
words.note: momentum = mass × velocity
words.trap: momentum ≠ speed؛ momentum به جرم هم بستگی دارد

words.example: The sun emits harmful ultraviolet radiation.
definitions: The emission of energy as electromagnetic waves or moving subatomic particles
words.coreMeaning: انتشار انرژی به صورت امواج یا ذرات
words.note: انواع: alpha، beta، gamma

words.example: The visible spectrum includes all the colors of the rainbow.
definitions: A band of colors produced by separation of light components
words.coreMeaning: نواری از رنگ‌ها بر اساس طول موج
words.note: طیف مرئی فقط بخش کوچکی از طیف الکترومغناطیسی

words.example: The nucleus of an atom contains protons and neutrons.
definitions: The central part of an atom or cell
words.note: جمع آن nuclei است
words.trap: nucleus ≠ core؛ nucleus اصطلاح علمی دقیق‌تر

words.example: Electrons orbit the nucleus of an atom.
definitions: A stable subatomic particle with a negative electric charge
words.note: الکترون‌ها در اطراف هسته می‌چرخند
words.trap: electron ≠ electricity؛ electron ذره، electricity جریان

words.example: A proton has a positive electric charge.
definitions: A stable subatomic particle with a positive charge found in atomic nuclei
words.note: تعداد پروتون‌ها عدد اتمی را تعیین می‌کند

words.example: Neutrons have no electric charge.
definitions: A subatomic particle with no electric charge
words.note: نوترون‌ها به پایداری هسته کمک می‌کنند

words.example: Carbon-14 is a radioactive isotope used in dating ancient objects.
definitions: Atoms of the same element with different numbers of neutrons
words.coreMeaning: اتم‌های یک عنصر با تعداد نوترون متفاوت
words.note: ایزوتوپ‌ها خواص شیمیایی یکسان ولی جرم متفاوت دارند

words.example: Nuclear energy is a controversial topic.
definitions: Relating to the nucleus of an atom
words.note: nuclear تلفظ صحیح: NEW-klee-er

words.example: Quantum mechanics describes the behavior of subatomic particles.
definitions: Relating to quantum mechanics or quantum physics
words.note: quantum از کلمه لاتین quantus گرفته شده

words.example: Light is an electromagnetic wave.
definitions: Relating to the interrelation of electric currents and magnetic fields
words.coreMeaning: مربوط به امواج الکتریکی و مغناطیسی
words.note: نور، رادیو و اشعه ایکس electromagnetic هستند

words.example: Coral reefs are one of the most diverse ecosystems on Earth.
definitions: A biological community of interacting organisms and their physical environment
words.note: اکوسیستم‌ها می‌توانند کوچک یا بزرگ باشند
words.trap: ecosystem ≠ environment؛ ecosystem شامل موجودات زنده

words.example: The rainforest has incredible biodiversity.
definitions: The variety of life in a particular habitat or ecosystem
words.note: شامل تنوع ژنتیکی، گونه‌ای و اکوسیستمی

words.example: Deforestation is destroying the habitat of many species.
definitions: The natural home or environment of an organism
words.coreMeaning: محیط طبیعی زندگی یک موجود زنده
words.note: habitat شامل شرایط آب و هوایی و غذا هم هست
words.trap: habitat ≠ ecosystem؛ habitat خانه یک گونه، ecosystem کل سیستم

words.example: The lion is the top predator in the African savanna.
definitions: An animal that naturally preys on others
words.coreMeaning: حیوانی که حیوانات دیگر را شکار می‌کند
words.note: shark یک apex predator است

words.example: Mice are common prey for owls.
definitions: An animal that is hunted and killed by another for food
words.note: prey هم اسم و هم فعل است
words.trap: prey ≠ pray؛ prey شکار، pray دعا

words.example: Factory emissions are a major source of pollutants.
definitions: A substance that pollutes the environment
words.coreMeaning: ماده‌ای که محیط زیست را آلوده می‌کند
words.note: pollutant می‌تواند شیمیایی، فیزیکی یا بیولوژیکی باشد

words.example: Carbon emissions must be reduced to combat climate change.
definitions: The production and discharge of something, especially gas or radiation
words.coreMeaning: تولید و آزادسازی گاز یا تشعشع
words.note: emission معمولاً به گازهای گلخانه‌ای اشاره دارد

words.example: The greenhouse effect is causing global temperatures to rise.
definitions: The trapping of the sun's warmth in a planet's lower atmosphere
words.coreMeaning: به دام افتادن گرمای خورشید در جو
words.note: CO2 و methane مهم‌ترین گازهای گلخانه‌ای هستند
words.trap: greenhouse effect ≠ global warming؛ greenhouse effect علت، global warming نتیجه

words.example: Deforestation in the Amazon is a major environmental concern.
definitions: The clearing or destruction of forests
words.note: جنگل‌زدایی باعث از دست رفتن تنوع زیستی می‌شود

words.example: Wind and water cause erosion of the soil.
definitions: The wearing away of rock or soil by natural agents
words.coreMeaning: ساییدگی خاک یا سنگ توسط عوامل طبیعی
words.note: فرسایش خاک مشکل بزرگ زیست‌محیطی است
words.trap: erosion ≠ weathering؛ erosion جابجایی، weathering تخریب در محل

words.example: Scientists found a fossil of a dinosaur in the desert.
definitions: The remains or impression of a prehistoric organism preserved in rock
words.coreMeaning: باقی‌مانده موجودات ماقبل تاریخ در سنگ
words.note: سوخت‌های فسیلی از بقایای موجودات باستانی ساخته شده‌اند
words.trap: fossil ≠ artifact؛ fossil طبیعی، artifact ساخته دست بشر

words.example: Solar and wind are examples of renewable energy sources.
definitions: Capable of being renewed or used again without being depleted
words.coreMeaning: قابل استفاده مجدد بدون تمام شدن
words.note: خورشیدی، بادی، آبی، زمین‌گرمایی

words.example: We need to find sustainable solutions to environmental problems.
definitions: Able to be maintained without depleting resources
words.coreMeaning: قابل حفظ در بلندمدت بدون تخلیه منابع
words.note: توسعه پایدار نیازهای حال را بدون آسیب به آینده برآورده می‌کند

words.example: Conservation efforts have helped protect endangered species.
definitions: The protection of plants, animals, and natural resources
words.coreMeaning: حفاظت از طبیعت و منابع طبیعی
words.note: conservation هم حفظ محیط زیست و هم صرفه‌جویی

words.example: The contamination of the water supply posed a serious health risk.
definitions: The process of making something impure by adding harmful substances
words.coreMeaning: ورود مواد مضر به آب، هوا یا خاک
words.note: contamination معمولاً محلی‌تر است

words.example: Many species face extinction due to habitat loss.
definitions: The state or process of a species ceasing to exist
words.coreMeaning: از بین رفتن کامل یک گونه
words.note: انقراض دایناسورها 65 میلیون سال پیش

words.example: The temperate zone has moderate temperatures year-round.
definitions: Relating to or denoting a region with mild temperatures
words.note: temperate zone بین مدارهای 23.5 و 66.5 درجه
words.trap: temperate ≠ temperature؛ temperate صفت، temperature اسم

words.example: The atmosphere protects us from harmful solar radiation.
definitions: The envelope of gases surrounding the earth
words.note: جو زمین از 78% نیتروژن و 21% اکسیژن تشکیل شده

words.example: Annual precipitation in this area is about 500 millimeters.
definitions: Rain, snow, sleet, or hail that falls from the atmosphere
words.note: precipitation شامل برف و تگرگ هم هست

words.example: The arid desert receives very little rainfall.
definitions: Having little or no rain; very dry
words.note: arid معمولاً برای مناطق بیابانی استفاده می‌شود
words.trap: arid ≠ dry؛ arid شدیدتر و علمی‌تر

words.example: The inundation of the coastal areas displaced thousands of people.
definitions: An overwhelming abundance of something; flooding
words.coreMeaning: طغیان آب و زیر آب رفتن
words.note: inundation رسمی‌تر از flood است

words.example: We should all try to reduce our carbon footprint.
definitions: The total amount of greenhouse gases produced by an individual or organization
words.note: شامل CO2 و سایر گازها

words.example: The ozone layer protects life on Earth from UV radiation.
definitions: A layer of the atmosphere that absorbs most UV radiation
words.coreMeaning: لایه‌ای از جو که اشعه ماوراء بنفش را جذب می‌کند
words.note: CFCها باعث تخریب لایه ازن شدند

words.example: Photosynthesis is the process by which plants convert sunlight into energy.
definitions: The process by which green plants use sunlight to synthesize nutrients
words.coreMeaning: تبدیل نور خورشید به انرژی شیمیایی توسط گیاهان
words.note: CO2 و آب → گلوکز و اکسیژن

words.example: Cellular respiration converts glucose into energy.
definitions: The chemical process in which organisms produce energy from food
words.coreMeaning: تبدیل گلوکز به انرژی در سلول‌ها
words.note: اکسیژن مصرف و CO2 تولید می‌کند

words.example: A fast metabolism helps you burn calories more quickly.
definitions: The chemical processes that occur within a living organism to maintain life
words.note: شامل آنابولیسم و کاتابولیسم

words.example: A strong immune system helps fight off infections.
definitions: The body's defense system against disease
words.note: شامل گلبول‌های سفید و آنتی‌بادی‌ها

words.example: The pathogen was identified as a new strain of bacteria.
definitions: A bacterium, virus, or other microorganism that can cause disease
words.note: شامل باکتری، ویروس، قارچ و انگل

words.example: The doctor prescribed antibiotics for the bacterial infection.
definitions: A medicine that inhibits the growth of or destroys bacteria
words.note: آنتی‌بیوتیک فقط روی باکتری اثر دارد

words.example: Childhood immunization programs have saved millions of lives.
definitions: The process of making a person immune to infection
words.coreMeaning: ایمن کردن بدن در برابر بیماری
words.note: immunization معمولاً از طریق واکسن انجام می‌شود
words.trap: immunization ≠ vaccination؛ immunization فرآیند، vaccination نوع خاص

words.example: Early diagnosis of cancer can save lives.
definitions: The identification of the nature of an illness by examination
words.coreMeaning: شناسایی بیماری از طریق بررسی علائم
words.note: جمع آن diagnoses است

words.example: Fever is a common manifestation of infection.
definitions: An event, action, or thing that is a sign or evidence of something
words.coreMeaning: نشانه یا بروز یک بیماری یا وضعیت
words.note: manifestation رسمی‌تر از symptom است

words.example: Early intervention can prevent the disease from spreading.
definitions: The action or process of intervening; action taken to improve a situation
words.note: intervention می‌تواند پزشکی، نظامی یا اجتماعی باشد
words.trap: intervention ≠ treatment؛ intervention اقدام، treatment درمان

words.example: The new drug is currently undergoing clinical trials.
definitions: A research study performed on people to evaluate a medical intervention
words.note: 4 فاز دارد

words.example: The scientist examined the cells under a microscope.
definitions: An instrument used to see objects too small for the naked eye
words.coreMeaning: ابزاری برای دیدن اجسام بسیار کوچک
words.note: میکروسکوپ الکترونی بیش از 1 میلیون برابر بزرگنمایی دارد

words.example: Galileo used a telescope to observe the moons of Jupiter.
definitions: An instrument designed to make distant objects appear nearer
words.coreMeaning: ابزاری برای نزدیک‌تر دیدن اجسام دور
words.note: تلسکوپ فضایی هابل تصاویر خارق‌العاده‌ای ثبت کرده
